meta.title: 高颧骨的他们算是把额头彻底玩明白了

scenes.title_cn: 立论：发际线=骨相的外在表现
scenes.title_en: Thesis: A Hairline Reflects the Bone Base
scenes.context: 林青霞能驾驭花瓣型发际线，别人做一模一样的却违和，因为发际线形状是额头骨相的外在表现，不是装饰品。
sentences: 为什么林青霞能够驾驭住花瓣型发际线，端庄不失柔美？
Why can Brigitte Lin carry the petal hairline, dignified yet soft?
the petal hairline（花瓣型发际线）
发际线的形状是额头骨相的外在表现，不是可以随便贴上去的装饰品。
A hairline's shape is the outward expression of the forehead's bone structure — not a decoration you can just paste on.
the outward expression（外在表现）
单看发际线挺好看，但放大到整张脸就是两个字：违和。
The hairline alone looks nice, but zoom out to the whole face and it's two words: jarring.
jarring（违和）
paraphrase: It just doesn't belong on the face.
scenes.speak: Why can Brigitte Lin carry the petal hairline, dignified yet soft? A hairline's shape is the outward expression of the forehead's bone structure — not a decoration you can just paste on. The hairline alone looks nice, but zoom out to the whole face and it's two words: jarring.

scenes.title_en: The Trapezoid Rule and the Brow Highlight
scenes.context: 好看的额头有上窄下宽的梯形。早期林青霞梯形上宽下窄、眉弓视觉高光点靠内，额头亮面局促、钝感明显。
sentences: 好看的额头都有一个上窄下宽的梯形，当这个梯形在额头上呈现得当时，额头开阔大气。
Pretty foreheads share a trapezoid that's narrow on top and wide below; when it lands well, the forehead feels open and grand.
a trapezoid（梯形）
眉弓视觉高光点的位置过于靠内，整个额头的亮面显得局促，不够大气舒展，钝感明显。
The brow's visual highlight sat too far inward, cramping the bright plane — not expansive, with an obvious dull heaviness.
the visual highlight（视觉高光点）
scenes.speak: Pretty foreheads share a trapezoid that's narrow on top and wide below; when it lands well, the forehead feels open and grand. The brow's visual highlight sat too far inward, cramping the bright plane — not expansive, with an obvious dull heaviness.

scenes.title_cn: 额结节点位：梯形与联动
scenes.title_en: The Frontal Eminence: Trapezoid and Linkage
scenes.context: 额结节把额头分为亮面/灰面。点位合适+眉弓高光外移→上窄下宽梯形出现→弱化脸宽；额结节包裹眉弓、眉弓呼应颧骨。反面：额结节过近+正方形额面→扁平局促显脸长；调整后正梯形+外框C包裹颧弓。
sentences: 当额结节的点位调整到合适位置，眉弓视觉高光点外移，上窄下宽的梯形就出现了。
Once the eminence is set right and the brow highlight shifts outward, the narrow-top trapezoid appears.
the frontal eminence（额结节）
开阔的额头反而能够弱化脸的视觉宽度。额结节的位置能够包裹住眉弓，眉弓向下能够和颧骨相呼应。
An open forehead actually narrows the face's visual width — the eminence wraps the brow, and the brow answers the cheekbones below.
to narrow the visual width（弱化视觉宽度）
额结节和眉弓以及眼眶形成联动关系，外框C能够顺势包裹住颧弓。
The eminence, brow and eye socket form a linkage, letting outer frame C wrap the zygomatic arch in one motion.
a linkage（联动关系）
scenes.speak: Once the eminence is set right and the brow highlight shifts outward, the narrow-top trapezoid appears. An open forehead actually narrows the face's visual width — the eminence wraps the brow, and the brow answers the cheekbones below. The eminence, brow and eye socket form a linkage, letting outer frame C wrap the zygomatic arch in one motion.

scenes.title_cn: 额顶额面与额颞转折线
scenes.title_en: Forehead Zones and the Turn Line
scenes.context: 两个骨点把额头分为额顶（承接头骨）和额面（衔接T区），形成高位收纳面中。额颞转折线（额结节+眉弓高光点）决定额头是球形还是T面。
sentences: 这两个骨点把额头的正面分为上下两个区域，上面为额顶，下面为额面。
These two bone points split the forehead into an upper top zone and a lower face plane.
bone points（骨点）
额顶承接头骨，额面衔接T区，形成我们面部的高位，能够收纳我们的面中。
The top carries the skull, the plane meets the T-zone, forming the face's high level that houses the mid-face.
to house the mid-face（收纳面中）
这条线让额头有了转折，带来了光影变化，也直接决定了额头是球形还是T面。
This line gives the forehead its turn and its light-shadow shifts, and decides whether it reads as a sphere or a T-plane.
a sphere or a T-plane（球形或T面）
paraphrase: Highs and lows across the face.
scenes.speak: These two bone points split the forehead into an upper top zone and a lower face plane. The top carries the skull, the plane meets the T-zone, forming the face's high level that houses the mid-face. This line gives the forehead its turn and its light-shadow shifts, and decides whether it reads as a sphere or a T-plane.

scenes.context: 隐藏细节：颞部饱满+发型打造卢米斯之圆，不是单一高颅顶，而是模拟饱满头骨形成头包脸。结语：看不懂的调整三年后成主流。
sentences: 还有个小细节就在于颞部的饱满。
There's one more small detail: full, rounded temples.
full temples（颞部饱满）
不是单一打造高颅顶，而是去模拟出饱满的头骨，形成头包脸。
It's not just building a high crown — it's mimicking a full skull so the head wraps the face.
a high crown（高颅顶）
你今天看不懂的调整，三年后会成为主流。
The adjustments you don't understand today will become mainstream in three years.
become mainstream（成为主流）
scenes.speak: There's one more small detail: full, rounded temples. It's not just building a high crown — it's mimicking a full skull so the head wraps the face. The adjustments you don't understand today will become mainstream in three years.

practice.a: A trapezoid narrow on top and wide below.

practice.q: 「收尾金句：三年后成主流」怎么说？
practice.a: Today's invisible tweaks become mainstream in three years.

pitfalls: Paste on a petal hairline without the bone base.
Work with the forehead's bone structure first.
Without the base, it reads as stage makeup on the whole face.
Fix only the hairline or only the crown.
Reshape the trapezoid, eminence and turn line.
Single fixes ignore the eminence-brow-eye-cheek linkage.
Make the forehead rounder and softer.
A weak turn leaves the forehead floating above a weaker lower face.
Chase trends you can't read yet.
What looks odd today often becomes the mainstream standard.
shifts: 以为发际线/颅顶是装饰，贴上就好
看见骨相：梯形、额结节、转折线、头包脸

footer_notes: 原视频为额头骨相美学口播（作者：张亚航），转录为繁体已转简体，英文为场景意译，适合跟读学习审美表达；ASR 术语已按语境校正（骨像→骨相、額節節→额结节、頓感→钝感、橘醋→局促、額捏→额颞、全弓→颧弓、美傷→美商、古典→骨点、孤叮叮→孤零零、捏布/額布→颞部/额部、蘆米斯之圓→卢米斯之圆、上進→上镜、神力→审美）。
